title: Boric's Task III (miniquest)
start: Speak to Boric in the workshop accessed from the stairs in Doric's hut, just outside the gates of Taverley north of Falador.

recommended.t: Falador Teleport or activated Falador lodestone

steps.t: Head down the stairs at Doric's workshop to speak to Boric. [Chat: 1 Do you have any Mining tasks for me? › Accept]
Head to the Mining guild. You must speak with one of the dwarves at the guild before mining. [Chat: 1 Boric sent me here to mine some ores.]
Mine 10 runite ore and 15 orichalcite ore.

sub.t: Boosts and perks such as Varrock armour, Shooting Star, and extra ore gained from leveling do count towards the 25 total ores.

steps.t: Return to Boric with the ore in your inventory (cannot be noted or in an ore box).
